title: Beartooth · Red Lodge to Cooke City
slogan: A 156 km loop out of Beartooth Pass
story: Alpine lakes, high altitude and an official status check before coffee. The stops in between: Top of the World store, Cooke City and Yellowstone northeast. Beartooth Pass is the high point. It tops out at about 2,850 m. It is a high-mountain day.

title: Colorado · Million Dollar Highway
slogan: A 232 km loop out of Silverton high town

title: Denver · Peak to Peak and Trail Ridge
slogan: A 248 km loop out of Golden
story: Thin air, big views and no mercy for late starts. 242 km round from Golden - plan on about 4 h 39 of riding. On the way it passes Peak to Peak Highway and Estes Park. The climb of the day is Trail Ridge Road. It tops out at about 3,250 m. It is a high-mountain day.
